newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen firm on foreign buy orders.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen firm on foreign buy orders.

text.p: Chilean stocks opened mixed but the bolsa expected to tilt higher later in the day, bolstered by foreign demand especially for supermarket chain Uniamrc, said traders.
Unimarc, which rallied on its New York debut Friday, is seen leading the Chilean bourse for the second day in a row, they said.
"There's great demand abroad and locally for the stock as the issue was small and (placement price) very cheap," said Jaime Pena y Lillo, portfolio manager at brokerage Socimer.
Unimarc opened up 1/2 in New York at 18-3/8.
The 40-share index opened unchanged at 120.6 points. The general index was off 0.02 percent at 5,387.67 points.
